2.  Issue notice to respondent returnable on 10 th June, 2021.
Learned APP waives service of notice on behalf of respondent.
3. Offence under Section 328 of the Indian Penal Code does not appear to have been made out.

4. Till the next date, applicant be released on interim anticipatory bail on furnishing PR bond of Rs.
15,000/- (Rs. Fifteen aba501.21.odt Thousand only) with one solvent surety in for the like amount,
in the event of his arrest in Crime No. 162/2021 registered with Jawahar Nagar Police Station,
Aurangabad, for offences under Sections 188, 273, 328 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, on condition that he shall not interfere in the investigation, shall not pressurise the witnesses and shall attend the police station as and when required to do so by the Investigating Offcer.
